defs.d: A fully grown human or animal.
A person who has reached the legal age of majority.
To (cause to) be or become an adult.
To behave like an adult.
Fully grown.
defs.ex: an adult human, animal, or plant

defs.d: Intended for or restricted to adults rather than children.
defs.ex: adult clothes

defs.d: A specification of an object or process, referring to requirements to be satisfied and thus conditions to be met for them to solve a problem.
A plan (with more or less detail) for the structure and functions of an artifact, building or system.
To plan and carry out (a picture, work of art, construction etc.).
To plan (to do something).
defs.ex: The king designed to mount an expedition to the New World.

defs.d: A mammal, Canis familiaris or Canis lupus familiaris, that has been domesticated for thousands of years, of highly variable appearance due to human breeding.
defs.ex: The dog barked all night long.

defs.d: Any member of the Family Canidae, including domestic dogs, wolves, coyotes, jackals, foxes, and their relatives (extant and extinct); canid.
To pursue with the intent to catch.
To follow in an annoying or harassing way.
defs.ex: The woman cursed him so that trouble would dog his every step.

defs.d: Meat from a dog eaten as food.
defs.ex: We visited South Korea this time around, where we ate dog meat for the first time.

defs.d: Meat prepared to be given to a dog as food.
Motivation to do or achieve something; ability coupled with ambition.
defs.ex: Crassus had wealth and wit, but Pompey had drive and Caesar as much again.

defs.d: Violent or rapid motion; a rushing onward or away; especially, a forced or hurried dispatch of business.
To provide an impetus for motion or other physical change, to move an object by means of the provision of force thereto.
defs.ex: You drive nails into wood with a hammer.

defs.d: To provide an impetus for a non-physical change, especially a change in one's state of mind.
defs.ex: My wife's constant harping about the condition of the house threatens to drive me to distraction.

defs.d: Traditionally the third of the four seasons, when deciduous trees lose their leaves; typically regarded as being from September 24 to December 22 in parts of the Northern Hemisphere, and the months of March, April and May in the Southern Hemisphere.
(by extension) The time period when someone or something is past its prime.
Of or relating to autumn; autumnal
defs.ex: autumn leaves

defs.d: A playful or competitive activity.
A video game.
To gamble.
To play card games, board games, or video games.
Willing to participate.
(of an animal) That shows a tendency to continue to fight against another animal, despite being wounded, often severely.
The period between sunset and sunrise, when a location faces far away from the sun, thus when the sky is dark.
defs.ex: How do you sleep at night when you attack your kids like that!?

defs.d: (Astronomy) The period of darkness beginning at the end of evening astronomical twilight when the sun is 18 degrees below the horizon, and ending at the beginning of morning astronomical twilight.
To spend a night (in a place), to overnight.
Ellipsis of good night
defs.ex: Night, y'all! Thanks for a great evening!

defs.d: A light meal usually eaten around midday, notably when not as main meal of the day.
A break in play between the first and second sessions.
To eat lunch.
defs.ex: I like to lunch in Italian restaurants.

defs.d: To treat to lunch.
A drug smoked or ingested for euphoric effect, cannabis.
defs.ex: After smoking a bowl of that fine marijuana, they ate some brownies.

defs.d: The hemp plant itself, Cannabis sativa.
Food consumed before going to bed.
Any meal eaten in the evening; dinner eaten in the evening, rather than at noon.
A drinker, especially one who drinks slowly (i.e., one who sups).
A daughter of the same parents as another person; a female sibling.
defs.ex: My sister is always driving me crazy.

defs.d: A female member of a religious order; especially one devoted to more active service; (informally) a nun.
defs.ex: Michelle left behind her bank job and became a sister at the local convent.

defs.d: To strengthen (a supporting beam) by fastening a second beam alongside it.
defs.ex: I’m trying to correct my sagging floor by sistering the joists.

defs.d: To be sister to; to resemble closely.
To look at and interpret letters or other information that is written.
defs.ex: Have you read this book?

defs.d: To speak aloud words or other information that is written. Often construed with a to phrase or an indirect object.
defs.ex: All right, class, who wants to read next?

defs.d: The process of interpreting written language.
The process of interpreting a symbol, a sign or a measuring device.
A device for transmitting conversations and other sounds in real time across distances, now often a small portable unit also capable of running software etc.
To call (someone) using a telephone.
A person who performs labor for a living, especially manual labor.
A nonreproductive social insect, such as ant, bee, termite, or wasp.
The edge of the land where it meets an ocean, sea, gulf, bay, or large lake.
defs.ex: The rocky coast of Maine has few beaches.

defs.d: The side or edge of something.
To glide along without adding energy; to allow a vehicle to continue moving forward after disengaging the engine or ceasing to apply motive power.
defs.ex: When I ran out of gas, fortunately I managed to coast into a nearby gas station.

defs.d: To sail along a coast.
A desire, wish, longing.
(often followed by of) Lack, absence.
To wish for or desire (something); to feel a need or desire for; to crave or demand.
defs.ex: What do you want to eat?  I want you to leave.  I never wanted to go back to live with my mother.

defs.d: (in particular) To wish, desire or demand to see, have the presence of or do business with.
defs.ex: Danish police want him for embezzlement.

defs.d: A being such as a monotheistic God: a single divine creator and ruler of the universe.
The single deity of various monotheistic religions, especially the deity of Judaism, Christianity, and Islam.
defs.ex: Dawn believes in God, but Willow believes in multiple gods and goddesses.

defs.d: The single male deity of various bitheistic or duotheistic religions.
A deity or supreme being; a supernatural, typically immortal, being with superior powers, to which personhood is attributed.
defs.ex: The most frequently used name for the Islamic god is Allah.

defs.d: An idol.
defs.ex: Leo Messi is my god!

defs.d: To put (something) in a place where it will be harder to discover or out of sight.
defs.ex: He hides his magazines under the bed.

defs.d: To put oneself in a place where one will be harder to find or out of sight.
An instance of a disease or poor health.
defs.ex: Her grandmother had passed away after a long illness.

defs.d: A state of bad health or disease.
defs.ex: Many working days this year have been lost through illness.

defs.d: A speaking or notice of anything, usually in a brief or cursory manner. Used especially in the phrase make mention of.
A social media feed, a list of replies or posts mentioning a person.
To make a short reference to something.
To utter a word or expression in order to refer to the expression itself, as opposed to its usual referent.

A facial expression comprised by flexing the muscles of both ends of one's mouth, often showing the front teeth, without vocalisation, and in humans is a common involuntary or voluntary expression of happiness, pleasure, amusement or anxiety.
defs.ex: He always puts a smile on my face.

defs.d: Favour; propitious regard.
defs.ex: the smile of the gods

defs.d: To have (a smile) on one's face.
defs.ex: I don't know what he's smiling about.

defs.d: To express by smiling.
defs.ex: to smile consent, or a welcome

defs.d: Act or instance of running, of moving rapidly using the feet.
defs.ex: I just got back from my morning run.

defs.d: Act or instance of hurrying (to or from a place) (not necessarily by foot); dash or errand, trip.
defs.ex: I need to make a run to the store.

defs.d: (usually in the phrase 'do a runner') A quick escape away from a scene.
defs.ex: He did a runner after robbing the drugstore.

defs.d: A deserter.
A woven fabric such as used in dressing, decorating, cleaning or other practical use.
Specifically, a tablecloth, especially as spread before a meal or removed afterwards.
To use up.
defs.ex: The power plant consumes 30 tons of coal per hour.

defs.d: To eat.
defs.ex: Baby birds consume their own weight in food each day.

defs.d: The heading or title of a magazine or newspaper article.
defs.ex: The headline on today's newspaper reads "John Doe Wins Wood-Splitting Competition."

defs.d: The line at the top of a page containing the folio or number of the page.
(entertainment) To have top billing; to be the main attraction.
The state of being actual or real.
defs.ex: The reality of the crash scene on TV dawned upon him only when he saw the victim was no actor but his friend.

defs.d: A real entity, event or other fact.
defs.ex: The ultimate reality of life is that it ends in death.

defs.d: As it was in the beginning.
defs.ex: Originally, this paper was white, but over the years it has yellowed with age.

defs.d: In an original manner.
defs.ex: They had to think originally to come up with those creative ideas.

defs.d: Contentment, ease.
defs.ex: Sleep in comfort with our new mattress.

defs.d: Something that offers comfort.
defs.ex: the comforts of home

defs.d: To relieve the distress or suffering of; to provide comfort to.
defs.ex: Rob comforted Aaron because he was lost and very sad.

defs.d: To make comfortable.
An ethical drug, one only dispensed on the prescription of a physician.
Of or relating to the study of ethics.
defs.ex: The philosopher Kant is particularly known for his ethical writings.

defs.d: Of or relating to the accepted principles of right and wrong, especially those of some organization or profession.
defs.ex: All employees must familiarize themselves with our ethical guidelines.

defs.d: Other than supposed; different.
defs.ex: He said he didn’t do it, but the evidence was otherwise.

defs.d: (manner) Differently, in another way.
defs.ex: Could I do otherwise than smile?.

defs.d: In different circumstances; or else.
defs.ex: I’m not well today, otherwise I would have helped.  You have to open your umbrella, otherwise you'll get wet.
